purpose: Historical facts paraphrased for isolated fixtures, not current news or verbatim page snapshots. RSS titles are test adaptations. Supporting test pages are synthetic and never fetched live.

events.title: Tesla updates Cybercab autonomy plans in its quarterly report
events.fact: The October quarterly update describes Cybercab and Robovan as vehicles designed for autonomy. This fixture dates the quarterly update, not their earlier unveiling.

events.title: NVIDIA announces Blackwell AI computing platform
events.fact: NVIDIA introduced Blackwell at GTC in March 2024 as an AI computing platform. This is a historical announcement, not a new release in 2026.

events.title: OpenAI announces GPT-4o multimodal model
events.fact: OpenAI introduced GPT-4o in May 2024 and described support for text, images and audio. This fixture makes no claims about current availability or measured performance.
